text: The system shall refuse an exchange with a person that it has not identified as the user.
rationale: REQ-PL-030 records the answer of the user as the platform received it from the user, and an answer from a person that nobody identified is not that. The means of identification is below this level.

text: The system shall give the user the agents that the user can reach.
rationale: INT-PL-15 brings them from Agent Definition, where REQ-AD-024 supplies them. DEC-088 makes the user choose the agent, so the user must be able to see what there is to choose.

text: The system shall attach an exchange in text to an agent that the user chooses from the agents that the user can reach.
The system shall attach every spoken exchange to the agent that holds the position that speaks to the user.
rationale: DEC-089. The user speaks to one agent whatever the subject. Whether speech and reasoning are one component is below this level. DEC-119 makes that agent the holder of one flagged position, which REQ-AD-064 gives.

text: The system shall give a documented interface through which a client that another person wrote attaches to an agent.
rationale: REQ-PL-011 and DEC-080. A client is not an external service under DEC-032, so it reaches this system and not External Access. This is the part of OPN-061 that this system holds. The acts that a client can reach are held by ACTUATION.

text: The system shall accept and return speech.
rationale: REQ-PL-010.

text: The system shall accept and return text.
rationale: REQ-PL-010.

text: The system shall let the user continue, in a second client, an exchange with an agent that started in a first client.
rationale: REQ-PL-010. The user uses an agent from more than one client. This does not make every surface of the platform available in every client.

text: The system shall return the first speech of a spoken turn within TBD.
rationale: OPN-003. A spoken turn must be fast and must read enough to feel that it knows the user, and the value is found by prototypes at subsystem level.

text: The system shall write each exchange that it carries to life state.
rationale: DEC-085. The purpose is not the record: it is what an agent derives from the exchange afterwards, which REQ-PL-018 states and REQ-PL-015 keeps apart from the observed exchange. REQ-IA-026, REQ-IA-027 and REQ-IA-028 state what State Custody receives with each exchange.

text: The system shall keep each unit of work that waits for the user available for the user to find.
rationale: INT-PL-10. DEC-104 has the caller raise the unit and keeps the choice of when to ask with an agent, and DEC-066 has Work and Coordination hold it, so the unit reaches this system from Work and Coordination and this system does not choose when to push it.

text: The system shall keep a unit of work that waits for the user available in any client that the user attaches.
rationale: A question that waits in one client is not seen by a user who uses another.

text: The system shall give the answer of the user to the unit of work that waits for it, as the user gave it.
rationale: DEC-084. This answers the half of OPN-049 that asks which system receives the answer. WORK AND COORDINATION holds the other side, OPN-064.

text: The system shall deliver to the user a message that a unit of work carries for the user.
rationale: REQ-PL-009 and DEC-082. The unit reaches this system over INT-PL-10 as any unit that waits for the user does. An agent writes each message and this system does not compose one. The record of the condition that started a message is not this system.

text: The system shall deliver a message by the means that its unit of work states.
rationale: OPN-075. The unit of a message states the means by which it is delivered, and the set of means is not fixed at this level. That means is an item of its own, apart from whether the user is told when the unit closes, which REQ-WC-089 makes false for a message (OPN-075).

text: The system shall give, for each message, that the user received it.
rationale: DEC-082. Work and Coordination holds the message as work in progress until the user saw it (DEC-120), and no agent can then read a closed unit as a message that the user received. WORK AND COORDINATION holds the other side, OPN-065. The first text gave whether the user opened, answered or acknowledged it. Work and Coordination waits on one event and does not judge it (DEC-095), and REQ-IA-019 holds what counts as received.

text: The system shall not give an affirmative answer that approves an action until the user confirms that answer in a step separate from the answer.
rationale: RSK-IA-001. Speech is weak evidence that the user said yes, and a device is not the user. DEC-084 keeps the voice agent in the exchange and makes the confirmation the answer that counts. The means of the step is below this level.

text: The system shall present, in the step that confirms an answer, the action as the unit of work states it.
rationale: RSK-IA-002. DEC-104 lets the agent that speaks the question state it in its own words, and binds the answer to the action as the request states it. What binds is what the user confirms, so the confirmation carries the action of the unit. The wording of the presentation is below this level.

text: The system shall give that the user received a message only when the user opened, answered or acknowledged it.
rationale: RSK-IA-003. A message that a service accepted is not a message that the user saw, and an agent that reads it as received assumes what the user knows. That the user opened, answered or acknowledged it is what the platform can observe.

text: The system shall end the identification of the user after TBD with no exchange.
rationale: RSK-IA-004. REQ-IA-017 protects an approval and does not protect what an exchange discloses or the work that it raises. A client left open is the common cause, and this bounds how long it stays open.

text: The system shall report to the user each identification from a client that it has not identified before.
rationale: RSK-IA-004. A person who is not the user and is identified as the user is not seen by the user without this.

text: The system shall give an answer only to the unit of work that it presented when the user gave that answer.
rationale: RSK-IA-005. Two units can wait at one time, and an answer that reaches the wrong one approves the wrong action.

text: The system shall report each exchange that it could not write to life state.
rationale: RSK-IA-008. A lost exchange is seen by nobody. DEC-120 lets this system hold an exchange until it is written, as state for its own work, and how it tries again is below this level. An exchange that it still cannot write is reported.

text: The system shall give, for each unit of work that waits for the user, whether the user opened it.
rationale: RSK-IA-009. A question that the user never opened stops the work that waits on it. DEC-104 keeps the choice of when to ask again with the agent, so this system reports and does not ask again itself. REQ-IA-012 keeps the unit in every client. The agent that asks receives this over INT-PL-33.

text: The system shall show the user the agent that an exchange is attached to.
rationale: RSK-IA-011. An agent other than the one chosen answers from a different position, and the user sees that only when the agent is shown.

text: The system shall state, with each exchange that it writes, the client of that exchange as its source.
rationale: INT-PL-28. REQ-ST-002 refuses a write of an observed item that does not state its source, and the client is where the exchange was observed.

text: The system shall write each exchange as an item of the kind of an exchange.
rationale: INT-PL-57. DEC-121: this system states the kind and no agent declares it. REQ-ST-060 refuses an exchange that is not in that form, and REQ-ST-061 refuses an exchange from any other writer.

text: The system shall state, with each exchange that it writes, the agent of that exchange.
rationale: INT-PL-32. What an agent derives from an exchange depends on which agent took part. DEC-121 makes it content of the item, which REQ-ST-060 accepts as part of the form of the kind.

text: The system shall keep available to the user each question and each message that the platform raises when it cannot continue to operate without an action.
rationale: REQ-PL-025 puts a question or a message to the user, and the user can answer or read it only if the user can find it. It is a unit that asks the user like any other, and REQ-IA-011 holds the same for requests that REQ-PL-012 needs. The first text said the work that the platform sends to the user. DEC-097: what reaches the user is a question or a message, and never work.

text: The system shall tell the user, in the exchange in which the user gave an answer, of each refusal of that answer, with the request that the answer was to.
rationale: DEC-094. An answer that arrives after its unit closed is refused (REQ-WC-061), and without this the user believes that the action was approved. INT-PL-35. OPN-077. The refusal returns while the answer is given, so the user is in that exchange. DEC-101 keeps a new message for the user with an agent, and this is the reply to the act of the user and not a new message.

text: The system shall not give an agent the state that it holds to identify the user and to carry an exchange.
rationale: DEC-120. This system holds the state that it needs for its own work. Given to an agent, that state becomes a fifth place that the user cannot see, limit or remove, which DEC-024 was written to prevent. OPN-067.

text: The system shall give State Custody the kind of an exchange, with a form that states whether the exchange is spoken or in text and the agent of the exchange.
rationale: DEC-121. The form of an exchange is an output of this system and not a judgement, so this system states it and no agent declares it. OPN-069.
